Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"buf/len","code":"archive_read_open(a, &buffer, NULL, reader_callback, NULL);","note":"The fuzzer passes attacker-controlled bytes into libarchive through a custom reader callback."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file","line":1518,"var":"extra_data_size","code":"if(block_flags & HFL_EXTRA_DATA) { ... extra_data_size = (ssize_t) edata_size; }","note":"RAR5 file headers can declare an extra-data region whose size is derived from the input stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file_extra","line":1410,"var":"extra_field_id","code":"while(extra_data_size > 0) { ... read_var_sized(a, &extra_field_id, &var_size);","note":"The parser iterates over attacker-controlled extra fields and dispatches by field id."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"process_head_file_extra","line":1440,"var":"EX_UOWNER","code":"case EX_UOWNER: ret = parse_file_extra_owner(a, e, &extra_data_size);","note":"A crafted EX_UOWNER extra field routes execution into the owner-name parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner","line":1349,"var":"value_len","code":"if ((flags & OWNER_USER_NAME) != 0) { ... read_var_sized(a, &value_len, NULL);","note":"The owner subfield length is attacker-controlled and is used to size the copy into a fixed stack buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libarchive/libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c","function":"parse_file_extra_owner","line":1359,"var":"namebuf","code":"memcpy(namebuf, p, name_len);","note":"If value_len exceeds OWNER_MAXNAMELEN, name_len becomes 256 and memcpy writes 256 bytes into namebuf[256], then namebuf[name_len] = 0 writes one byte past the stack buffer, causing the ASAN stack-buffer-overflow write."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print('updated')
PY
